name: core-bundles
description: The core's bundles on tables, D103's step 5 and D104: Reservation, Barrier, Mailbox and Assignment, each a table whose uses are the parts the loader expands the bundle into, as the fixtures of internal/loader/tsreader/testdata/services load them, which a Go test holds the defines here to (TestBundleScenariosAreTheLoadersParts). A bundle defines no rules, so the core runs its parts as it runs any table's uses. Cases written by hand in the recorded format, since no engine implements a bundle. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, and a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.
